verdict.rationale: Circle's docs describe integrating through REST APIs or Web and Mobile SDKs (Android and iOS) without managing raw private keys, with gas sponsorship via Gas Station or USDC paymasters and a chain-abstracted Gateway balance. Per-product OpenAPI specs and Bridge Kit, an SDK that moves USDC between chains in a few lines, further hide chain mechanics. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that developers never run nodes or RPC infrastructure, evidence of server-side client libraries across common languages (only Web/Android/iOS SDKs and Bridge Kit are cited), and independent or hands-on corroboration; some flows such as CCTP attestation retrieval still expose chain-level steps.
